# Gen5W Split Screen Blocker v1.2.0-rc.1

> [!WARNING]
> **Experimental prerelease — test-signed.** This is an independent fork, not DeFlight's official release. The signing key is disposable and will not necessarily match future builds. Remove any existing installation of DeFlight's mod before testing. Do not install both simultaneously.

## What's new

### Split-screen blocking for the Kia K5
- Adds the verified `canShowSSOsd(boolean, boolean, boolean)` hook to prevent the split-screen OSD from appearing.
- Recognizes the 2022 Kia K5 DL322 firmware `DL322.USA.0000.V015.012.260507` using ODEX MD5 `bd97b438aeb3d9c77510b5e2da4234f7`.
- Removes the two original panel hooks, retaining only the OSD permission hook and the two arrow-related hooks.

### Optional navigation arrow
- New **Enable navigation arrow** toggle, **off by default**.
- **Off:** split-screen OSD blocked, side arrow hidden.
- **On:** split-screen OSD blocked, side arrow available for the vehicle's native navigation view.
- A restart may be needed after changing the arrow setting.

### Packaging
- HMG-API test-signed mod ZIP and USB installer.
- NEMESIS packages where the packaging helper succeeds.
- SHA-256 checksums for the generated packages.

## Compatibility and testing

| Vehicle | Status |
| --- | --- |
| **2022 Kia K5 DL322, US 260507** | Individual hook behavior previously tested on-car; **this packaged RC not yet verified** |
| Kia Sportage-family US 260507 | Upstream version previously supported; **this RC not verified** |
| Hyundai Ioniq 6 US 260507 | Upstream version previously supported; **this RC not verified** |

The fifth hook is mandatory in this fork. If the required method is missing on a recognized firmware build, hooks will not install. Unknown ODEX signatures are ignored.

## Installation

Download the **HMG-API USB** archive, extract it to a USB drive and install through HMG-API. Alternatively, use a provided NEMESIS package. Remove DeFlight's original mod first; this fork currently uses the same mod ID but a different author signature.

## Feedback

Please report vehicle model, firmware version, `RightScreenHome.odex` MD5, and HMG-API logs with any problems. Testing the navigation-arrow toggle and verifying non-K5 firmware are the priorities for this prerelease.
